item.title: Cosatu slams Motus retrenchments as ‘heartless’ attack on workers and labour laws
item.description: The Congress of South Africa Trade Unions says it has been deeply alarmed by December reports that Motus, a major retailer, with several international franchises in its fold, retrenched over 80 employees and plans to cut over 900 staff members’ salaries by up to 30%.

item.title: National Red Meat Producers Organisation welcomes Foot and Mouth Disease vaccination strategy
item.description: The National Red Meat Producers Organisation said that they welcomed any strategy to try and curb and address the devastating outbreak of Foot and Mouth Disease

item.description: Knysna's water supply is under significant pressure, prompting authorities to urge residents and visitors to conserve water.

item.description: Donovan Ferreira’s (pictured) potential shoulder fracture could rule him out of the T20 World Cup, opening opportunities for Ryan Rickelton or even Ottniel Baartman to join the Proteas squad. Picture: Arjun Singh / Sportzpics for SA20

item.title: President Ramaphosa to assess flood damage in Mpumalanga as Limpopo's death toll increases
item.description: Floodwaters have damaged homes and infrastructure in parts of Mpumalanga and Limpopo following days of heavy rainfall.

item.title: Elon Musk demands $134bn, says OpenAI would not exist without him
item.description: Elon Musk is asking OpenAI and Microsoft to pay him damages amounting to $134 billion, according to a court filing submitted by his lawyer on Friday. The US-based billionaire claims that the company behind ChatGPT obtained “wrongful gains” from his early financial support.

item.title: Greenland row sparks showdown between Trump and Europe
item.description: The EU is preparing its most powerful trade weapons in response to US President Donald Trump’s escalating tariff threats over Greenland, opting to hold the measures in reserve while pursuing a last-ditch diplomatic solution.
